newsitem.title: JAPAN: Weak yen, stocks to hurt Toshiba Engineering - paper.
newsitem.headline: Weak yen, stocks to hurt Toshiba Engineering - paper.

text.p: Toshiba Engineering and Construction Co Ltd is likely to suffer a 30 percent drop in its parent current profit for 1996/97 because of the weaker yen and possible appraisal losses on its stock holdings, a Japanese newspaper said on Thursday.

The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said if the yen and Tokyo stock prices remain at their current low levels, the company's parent current profit will drop to 2.3 billion yen, down 600 million yen from the company's own estimate. The weak yen will make imported materials more expensive, the paper said. Company officials were not immediately available for comment.
